caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair positioned at an angle, showing the side and part of the front. The chair has a ladder-back style with three curved slats spanning the backrest, supported by two turned vertical posts that extend above the backrest into finials. The posts and supporting legs are cylindrical with rounded details. The seat of the chair is woven and has a natural beige color, contrasting with the medium brown color of the wooden frame. The legs and connecting rods at the base are also made of wood, and the chair rests on two long, curved rockers. The composition is centered on a plain, light-colored background with a faint rectangular border framing the entire image.
title: Rocking Chair
